name: burned-trailer
description: Origin trailer for BURNED — Remotion video project

scripts.render: npx remotion render src/index.ts BurnedTrailer out/trailer-landscape.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 18
scripts.render:spike: npx remotion render src/index.ts SpikeFrameTest out/spike-frame-test.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 18
scripts.render:thumbnail: npx remotion still src/index.ts BurnedTrailer out/thumbnail.png --frame 450
scripts.render:s01: npx remotion render src/index.ts PreviewS01ColdOpen out/s01-cold-open.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 18
scripts.render:s02: npx remotion render src/index.ts PreviewS02BriefingSetup out/s02-briefing-setup.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 18
scripts.render:s03: npx remotion render src/index.ts PreviewS03MissionBackground out/s03-mission-background.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 18
scripts.render:s04-peak: npx remotion render src/index.ts PreviewS04Peak out/s04-peak.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 18
scripts.render:s05: pnpm sync-gameplay && npx remotion render src/index.ts PreviewS05GameplayDissolve out/s05-gameplay-dissolve.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 18
scripts.render:full: pnpm sync-gameplay && npx remotion render src/index.ts BurnedTrailer out/trailer-scene-build.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 18
scripts.render:cold-open-4: npx remotion render src/index.ts SpikeColdOpenCandidate4 out/cold-open-candidate-4.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 18
scripts.render:cold-open-5: npx remotion render src/index.ts SpikeColdOpenCandidate5 out/cold-open-candidate-5.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 18
